# New-ZbxGraphPrototype

## SYNOPSIS

Creates a graph prototype.

## SYNTAX

```
New-ZbxGraphPrototype [[-Name] <string>] [-Uuid <string>] [-Discover <ZabbixDiscoverMode>] [-YMinItemId <ulong>] [-YMaxItemId <ulong>] [-GraphItem <ZabbixGraphPrototypeGraphItemRequest[]>] [-Width <int>] [-Height <int>] [-YAxisMin <double>] [-YAxisMax <double>] [-ShowWorkPeriod <bool>] [-ShowTriggers <bool>] [-GraphType <ZabbixGraphType>] [-ShowLegend <bool>] [-Show3d <bool>] [-PercentLeft <double>] [-PercentRight <double>] [-YMinType <ZabbixGraphYAxisType>] [-YMaxType <ZabbixGraphYAxisType>] [-AdditionalProperty <Hashtable>] [-Force] [-InputObject <PSObject>] [-Connection <ZabbixConnection>] [-WhatIf] [-Confirm] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

A graph prototype is the pattern a discovery rule turns into one graph per entity it finds. The New-ZbxGraphPrototype cmdlet sends graphprototype.create with one request field per parameter, then reads the new graph prototype back with graphprototype.get and writes it. The server requires -Name and -GraphItem; -AdditionalProperty sets any other field by its API name and wins over a parameter. -WhatIf shows what would be created, and the command needs a connection made with Connect-ZbxServer.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Create a graph prototype

```powershell
$item = Get-ZbxItemPrototype -Host 'web-01' -Name 'Used space on {#FSNAME}'
New-ZbxGraphPrototype -Name 'Space on {#FSNAME}' -GraphItem @{ itemid = $item.ItemId; color = '1A7C11' }
```

Creates a graph prototype named Space on {#FSNAME}. The command writes the new graph prototype, read back from the server.

## INPUTS

- `string`: Bound to -Uuid (ByPropertyName), -Name (ByPropertyName). Text.
- `ZabbixDiscoverMode`: Bound to -Discover (ByPropertyName). The discover mode values: ZBX_PROTOTYPE_* in defines.inc.php.
- `ulong`: Bound to -YMinItemId (ByPropertyName), -YMaxItemId (ByPropertyName).
- `ZabbixGraphPrototypeGraphItemRequest[]`: Bound to -GraphItem (ByPropertyName). gitems of a ZabbixGraphPrototypeCreateRequest.
- `int`: Bound to -Width (ByPropertyName), -Height (ByPropertyName). A number.
- `double`: Bound to -YAxisMin (ByPropertyName), -YAxisMax (ByPropertyName), -PercentLeft (ByPropertyName), -PercentRight (ByPropertyName).
- `bool`: Bound to -ShowWorkPeriod (ByPropertyName), -ShowTriggers (ByPropertyName), -ShowLegend (ByPropertyName), -Show3d (ByPropertyName). True or false.
- `ZabbixGraphType`: Bound to -GraphType (ByPropertyName). The graph type values: GRAPH_TYPE_* in defines.inc.php.
- `ZabbixGraphYAxisType`: Bound to -YMinType (ByPropertyName), -YMaxType (ByPropertyName). How a graph sets the minimum or maximum of its Y axis.
- `PSObject`: Bound to -InputObject (ByValue). Each object as the API answers it.

## OUTPUTS

- `ZabbixGraphPrototype`: The graph prototype read model, as returned by the Zabbix API.
